title: Evolving metal extraction processes
title_en: Evolving metal extraction processes
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
The metals industry has experienced transformational moments before: the Bessemer process, flash smelting, electric arc furnaces, and modern continuous casting all changed what was possible.

Yet, for more than a century, most extraction processes rely on techniques and pathways that would be familiar to metallurgists from generations ago. Processes have become larger and control systems smarter, but the fundamental science behind separating metals from ores has changed less than many realize.

title: Internal documents leaked by Cisco workers angry over the company's ties to Israel's military show how it expanded its business as the war in Gaza dragged on (Alice Speri/The Guardian)

author: The Guardian
content_snippet:
A year into the war in Gaza, the networks of Israel’s military intelligence community were plagued with technical problems. There were major, multi-hour outages to their systems, and repeated crashes. Built-in debugging mechanisms failed.

summary_en: Disgruntled Cisco employees leaked confidential internal memos protesting the company's military ties. author: Nous Research
content_snippet:
We post-trained over Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to reinforce Western values on a Chinese-trained model. We call this new model Arete-27B.

Why the name: Arete (ἀρετή) is the ancient Greek concept of excellence and virtue, the full realization of a person's or thing's highest potential. In physical geography, an arête is a narrow, sharp ridge of rock that separates two glacial valleys, which the cover of this post happens to depict.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 公开记录似乎显示 SpaceX 在德克萨斯州建造了一台“Starbase 超级计算机”，但吉娜·伊诺霍萨 (Gina Hinojosa) 当选州长可能会推迟一些数据中心计划。 调查反映出AI高耗能算力设施在地方落地时正面临严峻的电力供应、土地资源及公众环境关切阻力，AI基建扩张正在从单纯的技术投资转变为敏感的公共与政治议题。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Elon Musk moved early to build AI data centers in Tennessee and Mississippi and reaped the rewards.
